title: Indian Roast Cabbage
description: A simple and delicious Indian-inspired cabbage dish made with roast and butter. Perfect as a side or main course.
instructions: 1. Heat butter in a large pan over medium heat.
2. Add the chopped cabbage and roast, and sauté for 5 minutes.
3. Reduce heat to low and cover the pan with a lid.
4. Let the cabbage cook for 10-15 minutes, or until it's tender and lightly browned.
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
